I was unable to complete the fix. Despite multiple attempts, my edits to `django/contrib/admin/options.py` did not land the intended change — the file remained at its original state (the `lookup_allowed` condition at lines 467-470 was never actually modified). The repeated `str_replace` calls either produced no change (rejected as "old_str equals new_str") or introduced/removed only stray blank lines, which I then reverted.

The public regression selection (`modeladmin`, 162 tests) passed, but that reflects the unmodified baseline, not a fix. The target behavior — `lookup_allowed('restaurant__place__country', 'test_value')` returning `True` when a ForeignKey is used as a primary key — is NOT addressed by any change I made.

The intended fix (not applied) was to modify the condition in `BaseModelAdmin.lookup_allowed` so the "found from local model" shortcut only applies to genuine parent links (concrete inheritance), e.g. by checking `field.remote_field.parent_link` rather than relying solely on `field not in prev_field.path_infos[-1].target_fields`, which incorrectly treats a FK-as-primary-key as a parent link.

Status: incomplete. No functional change is in place.
